id: title:hpouillot:support scoped auth for all endpoints

review.posthog_relevance: Defines permission action scopes for assignment rules, bypass rules, and git provider file link resolvers, establishing the necessary configuration for permission enforcement.
review.reason: Adds action name lists to three viewsets, establishing the configuration required for permission checks. This is a necessary, localized maintenance and setup change. The chunk does not include the enforcement implementation, so the tier is capped at 1.
review.uncertainty: The actual enforcement and backend checks are not present in this chunk, so the benefit is dependent on future implementation; this chunk alone does not demonstrate the working permission system.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the permission enforcement or the backend permission checks, only the addition of action names and a test. The score cannot be assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a list of write actions to the assignment rules viewset.
observations.posthog_connection: Defines the set of actions that require write permissions for assignment rules, which could be used by the permission system to check access.
